news.summary: Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia CEO has brought renewed scrutiny to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and his family's financial ties to the chipmaker.

news.title: Kakao Prepares for Historic Split of Internet Empire in AI Chase
news.summary: Kakao Corp. spent over a decade consolidating South Koreans’ digital lives under one umbrella, but early next year it will go in the opposite direction to respond to the changes brought about by AI — splitting up.

news.title: Nvidia’s CEO Search Draws Fire With Bessent’s ‘Shakeup’ Call
news.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is urging Nvidia to make a "dramatic" leadership shakeup and come clean about its compliance with export controls on its AI chips. Bloomberg's Sunny Bangia has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Airlines Work to Restore Flights as FAA Probes Faulty Router

news.title: Netflix Resets Its Experiential Strategy

news.title: Taisei Launches $150 Million AI, Robotics Fund With Pegasus Tech Ventures

news.title: US, Allies Agree to Guard AI Supply Chains From China, FT Says
news.summary: The US and its allies have agreed to jointly identify and protect artificial intelligence technologies and supply chains considered vulnerable to China, the Financial Times reported Sunday.

news.title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang in Talks With Allies Over CEO Comeback, Report Says

news.title: China’s Yoozoo Gets $214 Million Flash-Memory Components Order

news.title: Firmus Plans to Raise $3 Billion After IPO Collapse, AFR Says

news.title: Korea’s Top Scorer in Tax Accountant Exam Admits to AI Cheating
